summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K containing its consolidated summary report under Japanese GAAP for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The filing presents routine annual financial results, including ordinary income of ¥14,620,843 million, ordinary profits of ¥3,410,192 million, and profits attributable to owners of parent of ¥2,427,229 million. It announces a dividend forecast of ¥96 per share for fiscal year ending March 2027. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transactions disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings release with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
